mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (below 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of instances with declining INDPRO, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between FEDFUNDS (above 4%) and CPIAUCSL (above 320) indicates a high-inflation, high-rate environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of high-inflation, high-rate instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 2 months, signaling labor market stress, investors anticipate reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in HOUST, indicating strengthening housing market, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as housing sector growth boosts economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances with rising HOUST, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
